title: The Passive with se in the Factories of the North

sections.title: What you already know
sections.content: You know the passive *se* from B1 Unit 6: *Se busca una persona*, *Se buscan personas*, *En esta oficina se organizan reuniones todos los lunes*. With a noun, the verb agrees with it; with no noun it stays singular (*se trabaja mucho aquí*). The passive *se* is the natural way to talk about trade and industry, where it matters what is made or agreed, not who does it.

sections.title: Singular, plural, no noun
rows: Se firmó un tratado en 1992 y entró en vigor en 1994. (A treaty was signed in 1992 and came into force in 1994.)
Se fabrican vehículos y aparatos electrónicos en el norte. (Vehicles and electronic devices are made in the north.)
Se trabaja mucho en las fábricas. (People work a lot in the factories.)

sections.title: The agreement to watch
sections.content: The noun that follows is the subject, so the verb agrees with it: *se exportan vehículos*, never *se exporta vehículos*. With a person as object, the verb stays singular and takes *a*: *Se contrató a los operarios*. When you stress the product, you can put it first: *Los vehículos se exportan a Estados Unidos*.

items.spanish: En el norte se fabrican vehículos y aparatos electrónicos.
items.english: In the north vehicles and electronic devices are made.

items.spanish: En el tratado se establecen reglas sobre los aranceles.
items.english: In the treaty rules about tariffs are established.

items.spanish: Se exportan vehículos a Estados Unidos.
items.english: Vehicles are exported to the United States.

items.spanish: Con el tratado se redujeron los aranceles entre los tres países.
items.english: With the treaty the tariffs between the three countries were reduced.

items.spanish: En las maquiladoras se ensamblan productos para exportar.
items.english: In the maquiladoras products are assembled for export.

sections.content: Ask what the noun after the verb is: if it is plural, the verb is plural. *Se habla español* but *Se hablan dos idiomas*.
